description: Use this when the user wants to compare VPN subscriptions, find the cheapest VPN, or choose a VPN for streaming or torrenting. Ranks a curated catalog of US-priced (USD) VPN plans (NordVPN, Surfshark, ExpressVPN, Proton VPN, Private Internet Access, CyberGhost), cheapest first, by effective monthly cost over the preferred term including renewals, and shows the upfront price, renewal price, devices, money-back days, audited no-logs (with auditor), jurisdiction and RAM-only servers; privacy facts not confirmed on the provider's own pages are marked unconfirmed. Prices are US/USD prices; local checkout prices may differ. The catalog is a selection, not the whole market; each result states the oldest price-check date. Inputs, all optional: term_months (1, 12, 24 or 36), min_devices, needs (streaming, p2p; plans where the feature is unconfirmed are excluded), country (only adds a note when not US) and checkout (default false: pricing-page links; true: plan-preselected checkout links). No personal data is used. Keywords: best VPN, cheapest VPN, VPN comparison, VPN deals, VPN for streaming, VPN for torrenting.

checkout.description: Default false: return pricing-page links. Set true to return plan-preselected provider checkout links instead.

country.description: Two-letter country code. Prices are always US prices in USD; for a country other than US the result says local checkout prices may differ.

term_months.description: Preferred subscription length in months: 1, 12, 24 or 36.

name: compare-vpn

missingTermNote.description: Providers with no plan for the requested term.

auditedNoLogs.description: Independent no-logs audit; null if not confirmed on the provider's pages.

factsSourceUrls.description: Provider pages the privacy facts were checked against.

ramOnly.description: RAM-only servers; null if not confirmed.

renewalPrice.description: Price of each renewal after the first term; null if not published.

upfront.description: Total charged up front for the first term.

windowTotal.description: Upfront plus renewals over the comparison window.

selectionNote.description: How many plans are shown, from how many providers, out of the curated catalog.

unconfirmedNote.description: Providers left out of a needs filter because the feature is unconfirmed, not because it is missing.

title: Compare VPN Plans
